note: Curated install facts. Mirror packaging/installer.iss + build.ps1 when they change. Not auto-generated.

download.how: Open latest_release and download the asset for your chosen platform/edition. If tools are available, use gh release download or curl to fetch the asset directly.

intake.note: Confirm the target machine and route BEFORE downloads, config/engine changes or login. The agent host is only a clue; reuse explicit prior answers, never silently infer cloud consent.
environment_scan: Detect host OS/arch, but ask whether the target is Windows or macOS; for Mac confirm Apple Silicon or Intel.
Check installed/running app, existing config and model cache without printing secrets or changing settings.
Check network/proxy and actual release assets; don't assume an ARM/Intel build exists.
Do not start account authentication until the relevant route/provider is confirmed.

questions.ask: Is the target computer Windows or macOS? If Mac, Apple Silicon (M-series) or Intel?
questions.ask_zh: 目标电脑是 Windows 还是 macOS？Mac 是 M 系列还是 Intel？
questions.note: Confirm architecture against available installer assets before downloading; do not infer the target from the agent host.

questions.ask: Do you prefer Azure, local processing, or a code-agent account? Hybrid setups are possible; recognition and text polish are chosen separately.
questions.ask_zh: 想走 Azure、本地，还是 code agent 账号？可以混用，但音频转文字和文字润色要分别确认。

questions.when: solution_route=code_agent or an account-based component is requested
questions.ask: Which account: GitHub Copilot, Codex/ChatGPT, Claude Code, or another? Copilot is text polish only, not audio transcription.
questions.ask_zh: 具体是 GitHub Copilot、Codex/ChatGPT、Claude Code 还是其他账号？Copilot 只润色文字，不直接转写音频。

questions.ask: Which recognizer should turn audio into text: local Whisper/MLX, Azure, or an explicitly accepted Codex experiment?
How should recognized text be polished: off, local rules/Ollama, Azure, or GitHub Copilot? Confirm cloud text/context disclosure and usage costs.

recommendation: Local recognition always needs Full, including local + Copilot text polish. Verify target architecture/build support first.
Offer local + rules/off for offline use, or local + Copilot for a suitable account; wait for agreement rather than silently picking Azure.
Copilot has no verified audio transcription channel here; its account only supplies text polish. Codex audio is experimental and not live-verified.
A new skill does not mean the latest published binary already contains these features. Check the actual version/settings/help before configuring.
Summarize platform/chip, edition, recognizer, polish engine, account/model and privacy/cost; execute only after confirmation.

handoff_requires: actual login started on target machine
fresh user code for GitHub device flow
notes: No hard-coded real device codes in examples.
Never read/copy pi, gh, VS Code or other agent credentials.
Login does not prove audio/model entitlement; verify stages separately.

editions.label: Full (bundles offline Whisper)
editions.requires: local model weights; a separate account only if cloud polish is chosen
editions.use_when: local recognition, including local + Copilot polish; only local polish is fully offline

windows.reinstall_config_note: Default 'Skip' never overwrites an existing config.json (FileExists guard). 'Basic setup' and 'Import' replace it.

editions.label: Full (local inference dependencies)
editions.use_when: local MLX / faster-whisper recognition, including local + Copilot text polish; verify chip/build compatibility

install_steps: On first launch, use the Settings panel to pick backend/model/Azure settings.
macos.model_note: The Full DMG includes local inference dependencies, but not model weights. Users choose an MLX model path/repo in Settings; the model downloads on demand.
agent_actions: Use gh release download --repo ThousandOfWind/bubble-buddy --pattern 'BubbleBuddy-Full-*.dmg' for local-model mac installs.
Attach the DMG with hdiutil attach.
Write ~/.bubble-buddy/config.json if the user wants a specific backend/model.
Open /Applications/Bubble Buddy.app and verify it starts.
macos.reinstall_config_note: The packaged app seeds ~/.bubble-buddy/config.json only when missing; existing config is preserved and merged with new missing defaults.

azure_setup.when: Only after an active Azure recognizer or polisher is confirmed; never infer this from the edition name.
agent_actions: Ask the user only for their Azure OpenAI endpoint (https://<resource>.cognitiveservices.azure.com/); never ask for an API key.

Merge azure.endpoint/auth and only the deployment required by the confirmed Azure component. Preserve the other recognizer/polisher, explicit models, hotkey and language; do not force both backend and polish_engine to azure.
Restart the app so it reloads config.
Hand off the sign-in: it needs an interactive browser the user completes; there is no CLI sign-in command.

signin_button.location: Qt desktop only: an orange banner above the pet, visible while signed out in both collapsed and expanded states; hidden after sign-in.
signin_button.on_success: Overlay shows 'Signed in to Azure'; auth record persists at ~/.bubble-buddy/auth_record.json and survives restarts.

native_macos_account_control.note: Expand the native overlay first. In mixed setups this control selects a required account, not necessarily Azure; follow accounts.md.

azure_setup.deployments_note: Ask only for deployments needed by active Azure components. Defaults gpt-4o-transcribe / gpt-4.1 are resource deployment names, not model-selection advice; verify they exist. Refresh cannot extend an expired Azure role or bypass tenant policy.

update.how: Download the latest installer/DMG of the same edition and run it over the existing install.
update.before: Fully quit Bubble Buddy so the executable/app bundle is not locked.
update.preserves_config: Windows: use the default 'Skip' path on the config page to keep config.json; Basic/Import overwrite it. macOS: replacing the app preserves ~/.bubble-buddy/config.json.

uninstall.how: Windows: Settings > Apps, or the Start-menu uninstaller. macOS: quit the app and delete /Applications/Bubble Buddy.app.
uninstall.leftover_user_data: ~/.bubble-buddy is not removed; delete manually for a clean wipe.
